text:
mira: Heads up — product is planning a gated prelaunch for the new checkout hotpath next Tue. PM says expected traffic could be ~2.5-3x our current peak for 4 hours, with elevated tail for the following 48h. Need quick capacity + SLA tradeoff discussion.

alex: Thanks. Do we have a GPU-hours projection? Also any region-specific constraints (APAC window)?

chao: Quick back-of-envelope: baseline peak = 120 GPU-hours/day across inference fleet. If hotpath is 3x for 4h and 1.5x for the rest of the day, rough extra = ~ (3-1)*4/24*baseline + (1.5-1)*20/24*baseline = ~40 + 50 = ~90 GPU-hours that day. Plan a 2x safety buffer -> ~180 GPU-hours extra for day0.

mira: That matches my calc. If we assume spillover for 48h (say 30% elevated), add ~72 GPU-hours. So ~252 GPU-hours incremental across the 72h window.

alex: Where will that pressure land? I expect most hits to hosted US-west and GCP APAC region. APAC has limited spare quota (we're at ~92% of reserved).

chao: Correct —APAC can only absorb ~30% of the extra. Rest will route to US-west/eu-west. We should reserve fallback to a quantized model variant for APAC and burst to dedicated capacity in US-west.

mira: Cost estimate? Ops needs to sign off on overspend.

chao: Estimated incremental cost using reserved pricing + on-demand burst:
```
Day0: extra 180 GPU-hrs -> ~$9k (on-demand weighted)
Day1-2: extra 72 GPU-hrs total -> ~$3.6k
Total ~ $12.6k plus networking egress (~$400)
```
Numbers rough, but ballpark $13k for the 72h window.

alex: Sounds reasonable. Can we reduce cost by enabling prefix caching or stricter batching on hotpath? Any latency risk?

chao: We can enable prefix KV caching for 60s TTL on the hotpath which reduces token generation by ~18% in our sim. Aggressive batching (batch window 10ms -> 30ms) gives extra throughput but tail latency risk rises ~8-12ms p95. For the checkout flow we have 150ms p95 SLO; pushing batch window is acceptable if we monitor closely.

mira: Action items: 1) infra to run quick surge sim (30m) with quantized variant + caching, 2) prod SRE to open temporary quota/burst in US-west, 3) PM to review canary rollout window and guardrails.

alex: I'll kick off the surge sim now and post results. tagging @sre-oncall for quota request.

sre-oncall: On it — I'll request temporary quota increase with cloud team and track approval. ETA 2-3 hours. If not approved, we'll auto-fallback more aggressively to quantized model in US-west.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: surge-sim-run (id: ssr-177200) queued by alex. Expected runtime ~28m.

chao: Simulation note — include an APAC-mirrored traffic pattern (70% of traffic shifted + 200ms higher RTT). That exposes queueing issues in the APAC LB.

mira: Also add cost cap alerting: create an ephemeral budget for the promo, threshold at +$6k trigger paging to ops.

alex: Results posted: surge-sim-run ssr-177200 -> peak GPU concurrent = +2.8x, KV cache saved ~16% tokens, p95 increased by ~9ms (within canary guardrail). Log: https://redwood.internal/sim/ssr-177200 (internal link)

mira: Great. SRE got quota approved (sre-oncall). We're green to proceed with dedicated bursts + cache. PM will limit rollout to 20% for first 30m then 50% for next hour.

chao: I'll open a short runbook snippet for the prelaunch hotpath: rollback flag, model-variant toggle, cache toggle, cost-cap circuit.

mira: Nice. I'll send a one-line note to execs after launch that we have buffer + budget. Thanks team :thumbsup:
